scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with cars and buildings on both sides. The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it. There are several cars parked along the side of the street, as well as some moving vehicles. There are also several pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. The buildings are mostly tall and have a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles. Some of the buildings have balconies and ornate facades, while others appear more plain. The sky is overcast with dark clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are primarily made of stone and brick, with some having large windows and others having smaller ones. Some of the buildings have decorative elements such as columns and arches. There are also some trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it. There are also some yellow markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk, as well as some streetlights and trash cans.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as some potted plants near the buildings.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including traffic signs and directional signs.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is mostly flat and smooth, but there are some uneven spots due to construction work.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The street is relatively open and spacious, with plenty of room for pedestrians and vehicles to move around.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, some of whom are carrying bags or backpacks.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is dim and overcast, with some shadows cast by the buildings.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Some people are sitting on benches or standing outside cafes, enjoying the view.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: Some people are waiting at bus stops or crossing the street.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: There are several visitors taking photos and exploring the area.
